milestones.title: A plan replaces the device-key signature on model exceptions with the person's credential

remediation: An exception that lets a named senior person allow a model for chat they review exists only under your organization's rules, which list the person's key; that key is the person's device key until a credential replaces it. The roadmap says Phase 71 replaces the signer, but no Phase 71 plan does it yet. Source: .planning/phases/74.1-model-passports-use-tiers-and-western-defaults/74.1-CONTEXT.md D-20.
title: Model exceptions are signed with a device key, not a person's credential
